lines.beaver_en: Director, oil prices are rising sharply these days.
lines.learner: 네, 유가 폭등으로 경기가 침체기에 들어섰습니다.
lines.en: Yes, the oil price surge has pushed the economy into stagnation.
lines.roman: ne, yuga pokdeungeuro gyeonggiga chimchegie deureoseotseumnida.

lines.beaver_en: Will you loosen fiscal spending? Are there enough funds?
lines.learner: 재원이 부족하다는 지적이 있어 재정 절감이 먼저입니다.
lines.en: It's been pointed out that funds are short, so cutting spending comes first.
lines.roman: jaewoni bujokadaneun jijeogi isseo jaejeong jeolgami meonjeoimnida.

lines.beaver_en: Then how will you support low-income households?
lines.learner: 고소득층에 세금을 더 걷어 저소득층에 분배하겠습니다.
lines.en: We'll tax high earners more and distribute it to low-income groups.
lines.roman: gosodeukcheunge segeumeul deo geodeo jeosodeukcheunge bunbaehagetseumnida.

lines.beaver_en: What about speculation? Housing prices have soared.
lines.learner: 부동산 투기를 막고 경매 물건도 낱낱이 조사하겠습니다.
lines.en: We'll block real estate speculation and examine auction properties in detail.
lines.roman: budongsan tugireul makgo gyeongmae mulgeondo nannachi josahagetseumnida.

lines.beaver: 주식 시장도 불안합니다. 어제 주가가 폭락했습니다.
lines.beaver_en: The stock market is unstable too. Stocks crashed yesterday.
lines.beaver_roman: jusik sijangdo buranhamnida. eoje jugaga pongnakaetseumnida.
lines.learner: 네, 급락 후 회복세로 돌아섰다는 분석이 있습니다.
lines.en: Yes, analysts say it turned to recovery after the sharp fall.
lines.roman: ne, geumnak hu hoebokseoro doraseotdaneun bunseogi itseumnida.

lines.beaver_en: How is the foreign exchange market? I'm worried about the exchange rate.
lines.learner: 수출 호조로 무역 흑자가 나서 외환은 안정적입니다.
lines.en: Strong exports created a trade surplus, so foreign exchange is stable.
lines.roman: suchul hojoro muyeok heukjaga naseo oehwaneun anjeongjeogimnida.

lines.beaver: 통상 문제는요? 관세가 오른다는 소식이 있습니다.
lines.beaver_en: What about trade? There's news that tariffs will rise.
lines.beaver_roman: tongsang munjeneunyo? gwansega oreundaneun sosigi itseumnida.
lines.learner: 관세 협의를 서두르고 통상 진흥 정책을 내겠습니다.
lines.en: We'll speed up tariff talks and announce a trade promotion policy.
lines.roman: gwanse hyeobuireul seodureugo tongsang jinheung jeongchaegeul naegetseumnida.

lines.beaver_en: Could you tell me about other measures too?
lines.learner: 아시아 경제권과 새 사업을 추진해 함께 번영하겠습니다.
lines.en: We'll pursue a new project with the Asian economic bloc and prosper together.
lines.roman: asia gyeongjegwongwa sae saeobeul chujinhae hamkke beonyeonghagetseumnida.

lines.beaver_en: Is the new project economically viable?
lines.learner: 경제성은 충분하고 투자금도 빨리 회수될 겁니다.
lines.en: It's viable, and the investment will be recovered quickly.
lines.roman: gyeongjeseongeun chungbunhago tujageumdo ppalli hoesudoel geomnida.

lines.beaver: 좋습니다. 이번 고비를 잘 넘기면 좋겠습니다.
lines.beaver_en: Good. I hope we get through this crisis well.
lines.beaver_roman: josseumnida. ibeon gobireul jal neomgimyeon jokesseumnida.
lines.learner: 네, 경제가 다시 거듭나도록 최선을 다하겠습니다.
lines.en: Yes, I'll do my best so the economy can be reborn.
lines.roman: ne, gyeongjega dasi geodeumnadorok choeseoneul dahagetseumnida.
